The '''Ion Jet engine''' was a type of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight drive]] [[Engine/Legends|engine]] developed by [[Koensayr Manufacturing/Legends|Koensayr Manufacturing]] for use on the [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighter]]<ref name="SWS" /> and the [[BTS-A2 Long-Range Strike Fighter/Bomber]].<ref name="Challenge">{{ChallengeCite|35|The H-Wing Strike Fighter}}</ref>
